# This script compiles the proj tool from source

set -e

# Check for required tools
if ! command -v g++ &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Error: g++ is required but not installed"
    exit 1
fi

if ! command -v make &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Error: make is required but not installed"
    exit 1
fi

# Compile the proj executable
echo "Compiling proj from source..."
g++ -O2 -o executable proj.cpp -lm

if [ -f executable ]; then
    echo "Build successful: ./executable"
    chmod +x executable
else
    echo "Build failed"
    exit 1
fi
